events.body:
## Context

`main()` in `compliance_checker.py` always returns 0, even when it prints an error, although README pitches the CLI for CI/CD pipelines.

## What to do

1. `sys.exit(2)` when `results['error']` is set.
2. Add `--min-score N` that exits 1 when the percentage is below N.
3. Document both in the README.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Error gives exit 2
- [ ] Score below `--min-score` gives exit 1
- [ ] README documents both

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 blt-owasp-wich/compliance_checker.py https://github.com/x; echo $?
```

---
